an9.69:1.1: LXIX. Pañc' imāni bhikkhave macchariyāni. Katamāni pañca? Āvāsamacchariyaṃ, kulamacchariyaṃ, lābhamacchariyaṃ, vaṇṇamacchariyaṃ, dhammamacchariyaṃ. Imāni kho bhikkhave pañca macchariyāni.
an9.69:2.1: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ macchariyānaṃ pahānāya . . . cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā ti.
